verdict.rationale: The official getting-started docs list the CLI alongside the SDKs, REST API and Web UI as a way to run a parse job. The API reference lists a versioned first-party "CLI tool 1.9.0", so an official CLI exists. Evidence is limited to these two brief mentions, with no detail on commands or agent-friendly behavior. Missing for 10: documented CLI commands/usage examples, coverage of Extract/Classify/Split via CLI, AI-native features (e.g., machine-readable output, agent invocation guidance), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
